decided_by: ake2l (requested enforceable typed APIs); Codex implementation, independent Astra review before merge
rationale: Issue #541 adds 34 independently authored dependency API Target entities and a narrow native boundary_types rule for the shared dependency-policy module. Enum kinds, closed mode fields, selector/selection methods, legacy wrapper parameters and return types, and record conversion are explicit intent. Actual source mutation controls reject type widening and undeclared helper imports. This strengthens the intended contract; the fail-closed classifier cannot enumerate UML declaration changes. No publication, permission, baseline entry, measurement ceiling, wildcard exception or accepted debt is widened. docs/architecture/dependency-selector-target.md records the guarantee and limits.
